children: European energy stocks are down in European morning trading. Oil had been up earlier in the day on renewed security threats to Middle Eastern oil shipments but is currently down. Front-month Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, falls 0.4% to $97.82 a barrel. West Texas Intermediate, the U.S. benchmark, falls 0.6% to $89.99 a barrel. In London, Shell and BP are down 2%. France's TotalEnergies sheds 1.4%; Spain's Repsol and Italy's Eni both fall around 1.8%. Norway's Equinor loses 2.9%. (adam.whittaker@wsj.com)
